Oluwaseun Oyemakinde

GIS Analyst | Remote Sensing Specialist | Hydrographic Data Processor

From offshore survey data to spatial intelligence — turning raw geospatial data into decisions that matter

docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I am a geospatial analyst specialising in GIS, remote sensing, and hydrographic data processing, with experience transforming complex spatial datasets into actionable insights. My background combines offshore survey operations, geospatial analysis, and operational data management, supported by an MSc in Geographic Information Systems from the University of Aberdeen.

I work with ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Python, SQL, PostGIS, and remote sensing platforms to analyse, visualise, and communicate spatial information. My experience processing multibeam sonar, positioning data, satellite imagery, and environmental datasets has developed a strong foundation in data quality, spatial analysis, and geospatial problem-solving.

Through this portfolio, I showcase projects involving GIS analysis, remote sensing, spatial databases, and data-driven decision support. I am passionate about using geospatial technology to solve real-world challenges across environmental monitoring, infrastructure, marine operations, and public sector planning.

docs.title: Hydrographic Data Processor / Geospatial Data Analyst — Acteon Geo-services (UTEC NCS Survey)
docs.text:
June 2024 – Present | Aberdeen, UK

  • Process, analyse, and quality-assure large hydrographic and geospatial datasets — including multibeam echosounder, side-scan sonar, and GNSS positioning data — to support offshore infrastructure projects and spatial decision-making
  • Maintain comprehensive processing logs, metadata records, and offset documentation to uphold traceability, repeatability, and regulatory compliance
  • Produce professional charts, maps, and spatial deliverables in AutoCAD Map 3D, meeting tight deadlines for offshore infrastructure clients

docs.title: Assistant Project Manager (Contract) — Net Zero Technology Centre
docs.text:
Jun – Aug 2023 | Aberdeen, UK

  • Supported an industry-led R&D collaboration programme on robotics and autonomous systems for remote offshore energy assets, developing an evidence-based business case for senior decision-making
  • Gathered, analysed, and documented project requirements, reviewing objectives for compliance with grant award conditions
  • Supported investment packaging for the Offshore Low-Touch Energy Robotics (OLTER) programme, communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

docs.title: GIS Technician / UAV Sensor Operator — United Nations MINUSCA
docs.text:
Sep 2020 – Aug 2022 | Central African Republic

  • Created and maintained high-quality spatial datasets and patrol route maps for joint task force operations across Bangui, enabling evidence-based operational planning for 500+ personnel
  • Utilised the Geographic Information Assistant (GINA) to track and visualise multi-agency movement data, enhancing situational awareness across a UN peacekeeping theatre
  • Delivered ISR reports, cartographic products, and spatial analysis outputs to command teams under time-critical conditions

  • Managed a team of four technicians, optimising workflows and ensuring operational readiness across concurrent assignments
